event-horizon.title: Event Horizon
event-horizon.what: A cosmic physics sandbox: bend gravity, feed black holes, set off supernovas, then rewind.
event-horizon.status: shipped, live. 105 unit tests + 18 browser checks. not tried on real touch hardware yet.

Pipo.title: Pipo
Pipo.what: A little robot who lives in your phone. Close the app and he builds, naps and heads out; come back and he tells you what happened.

campus-bus.title: Campus Bus
campus-bus.what: A college bus reservation system: find a bus that passes your stop, pick a seat on a picture of the bus, get a pass.
campus-bus.status: shipped v1.1. 166 tests, tried on one PC so far.

codeflow.title: CodeFlow
codeflow.what: A learning workspace that makes program state visible, for beginners in C, HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
codeflow.status: shipped v1.0.0. 54 unit + 84 local browser + 70 production browser checks.

Kio.title: KIO
Kio.what: The kernel of my companion runtime, rebuilt one gate at a time.
Kio.status: building. gates C-1 to C-3 done, C-4 next. Phase 0 deleted 5,167 lines.

Universal-Engineering-Augmentation.title: UEA
Universal-Engineering-Augmentation.what: Real tools for coding agents, so the model stops guessing what a tool can prove.
Universal-Engineering-Augmentation.status: public alpha, v0.1.0. token savings: not measured yet.

AURA.title: AURA
AURA.what: Memory for KIO: working, episodic and semantic memory behind an API.
AURA.status: built, not verified. last touched June 2026.

rag-platform.title: RAG Platform
rag-platform.what: A local-first RAG foundation. Hybrid retrieval and generation are planned, not built yet.
rag-platform.status: building, phase 3 complete. egress off by default.

gh-ops.title: gh-ops
gh-ops.what: My GitHub chores on autopilot: six jobs through one dispatcher, and a Telegram ping only when something happened.

oss-atlas.title: OSS Atlas
oss-atlas.what: My running log of open-source work: case studies and a ledger of upstream fixes.
